title: Blacks is to Anger as Whites is to Joy? Understanding Latent Affective Bias in Large Pre-trained Neural Language Models
reasoning: The paper explicitly evaluates and benchmarks 'Affective Religious Bias' in large language models (BERT, GPT-2, XLNet, and T5) using target terms related to Christian, Muslim, and Jewish social groups. It includes specific sections and data analysis regarding religious associations with various emotions.
